label: Assignment rule
description: Routes records to a group when a condition holds, such as sending network tickets to the Network queue. Rules are evaluated in order and the first match sets the entity's assignment group field (assignment_group on tickets). The group is named by key and resolved per tenant.
usage: Write one rule per routing decision with a precise when.
Use order to put specific rules (category and priority) before general ones.
Keep a catch-all rule (when "true") last to route to the service desk.
constraints: when is a CEL-subset expression over record; group is a group key that must resolve to a group in the tenant, otherwise the rule is skipped with a warning.
Evaluated in ascending order (ties by ID); the first matching enabled rule wins.
Runs on create and when a field used in when changes, and only while the assignment group is empty or was set by an assignment rule — manual assignments are never overwritten.

binding.description: Configuration object in a layer's spec catalog; not a layout node.
